{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display basic info
df_info = sales_df.info()

# Display first few rows
df_head = sales_df.head()

# Display unique values for key columns
df_columns = sales_df.columns.tolist()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Return all results
df_info, df_head, df_columns, missing_values, duplicates"}
